passages.title: Recording 1
passages.text: Woman: Are you coming to the shopping centre later? Man: I'd love to, but I have to finish my history project first. Maybe I can meet you there at five o'clock instead?

passages.title: Recording 2
passages.text: Boy: I need to buy a new pair of trainers for the school trip. Do you think these blue ones look okay? Girl: They look cool, but they are quite expensive. Why don't you check the ones on sale?

passages.title: Recording 3
passages.text: Woman: Have you decided what to wear for the party on Saturday? Man: I was going to wear my suit, but it needs cleaning. I think I'll just wear my new jeans and a shirt.

passages.title: Recording 4
passages.text: Man: I'm planning to go to the cinema this evening. Would you like to come? Woman: That sounds great! I've been wanting to see that new comedy film for ages.

passages.title: Recording 5
passages.text: Girl: I'm going to the supermarket to get some snacks for our picnic tomorrow. Do you want anything specific? Boy: Could you get some apples and maybe some orange juice?

passages.title: Recording 6
passages.text: Woman: I've finally finished my shopping for the holiday. I bought a new swimsuit and a sun hat. Man: That's good! I still need to find some comfortable sandals.

passages.title: Recording 7
passages.text: Man: What time are we meeting for the concert? Woman: The doors open at seven, so let's meet outside the main entrance at half past six.

questions.question: When will the man meet the woman?
questions.explanation: The man says he can meet at five o'clock after finishing his project.
options: a) At five o'clock
b) At the shopping centre in the morning
c) Before he starts his project

questions.question: What does the girl suggest?
questions.explanation: The girl suggests looking at the trainers on sale because the others are too expensive.
options: a) Looking at the trainers on sale
b) Not buying any trainers at all
c) Buying the blue trainers immediately

questions.question: What will the man wear to the party?
questions.explanation: The man decides to wear jeans and a shirt because his suit needs cleaning.
options: a) Something he bought recently
b) Jeans and a shirt
c) A clean suit

questions.question: What is the woman's reaction to the invitation?
questions.explanation: The woman says it sounds great and expresses interest in the comedy film.
options: a) She prefers a different type of film
b) She is too busy to go
c) She is happy to accept

questions.question: What does the boy ask for?
questions.explanation: The boy requests apples and orange juice for the picnic.
options: a) Snacks for the supermarket
b) A specific type of picnic basket
c) Apples and orange juice

questions.question: What does the man still need to buy?
questions.explanation: The man mentions he still needs to find comfortable sandals.
options: a) Sandals
b) A swimsuit
c) A sun hat

questions.question: Where and when will they meet?
questions.explanation: They agree to meet outside the main entrance at 6:30.
options: a) Inside the concert hall at seven
b) Outside the entrance at 6:30
c) At the main entrance at seven
